elements.label: A New Start?
elements.description: A chance to regroup and make a comeback.

elements.label: Serious Injury
elements.description: A major setback! This kind of damage cannot heal without external help.

elements.label: Wound
elements.description: The flesh always has its limits. [Some wounds heal with the passage of time, but sustaining three wounds of any kind at once will prove fatal.]

elements.label: Ally
elements.description: Those who share benefits with me.

elements.label: Foe
elements.description: We will settle this, sooner or later.

elements.label: Location
elements.description: A place worth going to. I might find something here, or carry out some work.

elements.label: Season
elements.description: What I foresee will come to pass...

elements.label: 隐藏性相：步枪
elements.description: 隐藏标记，用于标识步枪。

elements.label: Ammunition
elements.description: Unarrived flames.

elements.label: Molten
elements.description:
Emitting infernal-like heat, capable of melting through supernatural defenses.

[Using this to attack nullifies an enemy's 'Twisting' and 'Buffering'.]

elements.label: Piercing
elements.description:
A brutal cold overflows, ensuring the arrival of the end.

[Using this to attack nullifies an enemy's 'Resistant' and 'Revival'.]

elements.label: Profane
elements.description:
This object possesses unimaginable supernatural power, capable of even breaking through blessings and protections bestowed by gods.

[When attacking with this card, the strike is guaranteed to land, and all of the enemy's traits are rendered null.]

elements.label: Threshold: Edge
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Edge can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Forge
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Forge can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Grail
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Grail can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Heart
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Heart can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Secret History
elements.description: Invoking potential beneath Histories can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Knock
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Knock can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Lantern
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Lantern can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Moth
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Moth can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Winter
elements.description: Invoking an equal force of Winter can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Molten Blade
elements.description: Invoking the forces of Edge and Forge in equal measure—or combining Edge with a certain sublime molten thing—can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Piercing Blade
elements.description: Invoking the forces of Winter and Forge in equal measure—or combining Edge with a certain sublime piercing thing—can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Threshold: Profane Blade
elements.description: Invoking the forces of Edge and lantern in equal measure—or combining Edge with a certain sublime ruthless thing—can overcome this challenge.

elements.label: Trait: Buffering
elements.description: This being's unique form makes it difficult to kill in a single strike. [Foes with this aspect are immune to the first attack, but lose this aspect once struck. You may also bypass this aspect by attacking with a molten weapon.]

elements.label: Trait: Deadly
elements.description: A presence of singular peril—before it, one would do well not to lower their guard. [Foes with this aspect deal far greater damage when attacking.]

elements.label: Trait: Resistant
elements.description: This being possesses extraordinary resilience, allowing it to potentially survive even under the most severe conditions. [Foes with this aspect have a 30% chance to survive an otherwise fatal attack, unless you strike with a piercing weapon. ]

elements.label: Trait: Revival
elements.description: This being possesses unusual vitality, making it difficult to permanently subdue. [Foes with this aspect require two attacks to be killed—otherwise they will recover after some time. A piercing weapon can nullify this trait.]

elements.label: Trait: Sneaky
elements.description: This being is adept at concealing its presence. [Foes with this aspect will enter a hidden form after attacking.]

elements.label: Trait: Twisting
elements.description: This being is granted preservation by the Hour it serves, distorting reality around it, making ordinary weapons rarely effective. [Attacks against this enemy have only a 30% chance to succeed, unless a molten weapon is used.]

elements.label: Trait: Vengeful
elements.description: A reckoning is not to be postponed indefinitely... [Allies who strike this enemy have a 70% chance of being killed.]

elements.label: Hidden
elements.description:
Nowhere to be found.

[You cannot attack foes in this state, but they can be revealed by using specific ability.]

elements.label: Wound of A Name
elements.description:
The flesh always has its limits, and for them it is no different.
[Gather three to bring down this enemy.]

elements.label: Wound of the Wolf
elements.description:
A god who styles itself unmaking—can it, too, be unmade?
[Gather seven, and perhaps...]

elements.label: 所需距离
elements.description:
用于标记到达目的地所需的进度。
[*此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: Malice
elements.description:
A manifestation of a hostile Hour's power, currently permeating this reality.

[Can be utilized by certain foes, making them even more powerful.]

elements.label: Trade with Necessities
elements.description: Many things cannot be exchanged for money, but few things remain truly priceless in times of war.

elements.label: Local
elements.description: I cannot take this. [This card will be purged when changing regions.]

elements.label: Workable
elements.description: I can use this to use my own abilities.

elements.label: Forgeable
elements.description: Can undergo further working and processing.

elements.label: Consumable
elements.description: It has a disposable use.

elements.label: Required for Shaping
elements.description: Can be used for shaping and working.[You can craft items here, or use appropriate resources to restore one damaged Health.]

elements.label: Sun Shrine
elements.description: A secret cult site dedicated to the Solar Hours. [You may gain Influence here, or use appropriate resources to restore one damaged Reason.]

elements.label: The Vagabond's Steps
elements.description: The Vagabond once passed here and left a gift at the end of the road. [Completing the exploration will restore one damaged Passion — If no Passion is damaged, they grant you useful resources.]

elements.label: 不合适
elements.description:
作者不希望你把这玩意丢到奇奇怪怪的地方。
[此性相应被隐藏，用于标记不具有准则的机会，他们不该被丢入挑战或铸造厂中。]

elements.label: Obstacle Count
elements.description: [You must overcome this many obstacles to achieve the outcome.]

elements.label: 区域难度
elements.description: 模组判断游戏进程的标准，影响敌人ai和技能表现。游戏进程越靠后，难度数值越高。

elements.label: Obstacle
elements.description: A difficulty that must be overcome.

elements.label: 隐藏标记：精神
elements.description: 判定卡牌是否是精神攻击的目标。

elements.label: Threat
elements.description:
An indicator used to gauge the danger level of foes. If left unattended, an obstacle that initially appears weak can grow to become extremely deadly.

[If this reaches 10, you will be in an extremely dangerous situation.]

elements.label: Goal
elements.description: This matter deserves a more detailed investigation and follow-up.

elements.label: Promoted
elements.description: This Influence has been promoted by the Chandler's Desire.

elements.label: Flame Bearer
elements.description:
Beings that exist and act through my divine fire. I cannot possess too many at once, lest the flame be scattered too thin.
[Special allies created via the Forge Heart are marked by this aspect. This aspect cannot total more than 12 in play.]

elements.label: The Site of the Foundry
elements.description:
Here there is a place where I may work.
[The Foundry can be used to restore damaged Health, and for other practical works.]

elements.label: The Site of the Sun Shrine
elements.description:
Here lies a potent sanctum to draw upon.
[The Sun Shrine can be used to restore damaged Reason, and for other practical works.]

elements.label: The Site of the Vagabond
elements.description:
The Vagabond has left footprints and power in this place.
[The Vagabond's Steps can be used to restore damaged Passion. If no Passion is damaged, they grant you useful resources.]

elements.label: 绳结诸神的恶意
elements.description: 允许绳结戍边者利用对应的恶意。

elements.label: 清除标记：一般敌人
elements.description:
用于清除一般敌人相关卡牌。
[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: 清除标记：敌对团体
elements.description:
用于清除敌对团体相关卡牌。
[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: 清除标记：猎人
elements.description:
用于清除猎人相关卡牌。
[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: 清除标记：逻辑
elements.description:
用于清除决定各类策略的逻辑卡排。
[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: 通用清除标记
elements.description:
用于在切换地区时清除对应卡牌。
[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: Intent
elements.description: A notion worthy of proclamation.

elements.label: Destined Land
elements.description:
The road has reached its end, and all my fates shall be made manifest here.
[The Huntresses will not pursue you to this place—if all is prepared, this is also where you may claim your victory.]

elements.label: Stability
elements.description:
No matter how exquisite Ys' defenses may be, they cannot hold for long against an assault of this magnitude. These are the last hours she has left.
[Complete your ascension as quickly as possible—if Ys loses all of this aspect, the game will end in failure.]

elements.label: 标记：绳结戍边者无法入场
elements.description: 阻止绳结戍边者入场。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: 标记：斯卡蒂无法入场
elements.description: 阻止斯卡蒂入场。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.description: 阻止老成仔猫入场。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: 标记：拉吉亚无法入场
elements.description: 阻止拉吉亚入场。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: 隐藏标记：猎手在此
elements.description: 一名猎手已在此地。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: 隐藏标记：无法离开
elements.description: 使你无法离开当前地区。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: 结算点数：制烛人
elements.description: 计算demo版本中制烛人大胜路线的收集数。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.description: 计算demo版本中日归正午大胜路线的收集数。[此性相应被隐藏。]

elements.label: Mana Depleted
elements.description:
The ritual I performed has completely drained the residual power of this place. It remains open for worship, but the power once hidden within is no longer as it was.

[This sanctuary can no longer be used to restore Reason and other complicated works.]

elements.label: Heat Dissipates
elements.description: My operations have caused some irreversible damage to the equipment in this area.[This foundry can no longer be used to restore Health and other complicated works.]

elements.label: The Journey I Have Traveled
elements.description: I have walked so many long roads, and I will remember how to overcome the obstacles along the way.[These Progress will be retained.]

elements.label: Formula Hint: Ammunition
elements.description:
Sharp Alloy Projectiles
4 Edge, Supplies, Ammunition
Formula Requirements: 10 Edge + 6 Forge + 2 Supplies + 1 Tool

Bitterblack Salt
6 Forge, 2 Edge, 2 Knock, Supplies, Ammunition
Formula Requirements: 12 Forge + 4 Edge + 4 Winter + 2 Supplies + 1 Tool

elements.label: Formula Hint: Alchemical Materials
elements.description:
Xanthotic Essence
8 Forge, Supplies
Formula Requirements: 20 Forge + 8 Lantern + 8 Winter + 2 Bitterblack Salt
Iotic Essence
12 Forge, Supplies
Formula Requirements: 30 Forge + 15 Lantern + 2 Xanthotic Essence
Blue Gold
8 Edge 8 Forge 8 Knock 8 Lantern 8 Winter, Unique, doesn't consume after use
Formula Requirements: 40 Forge + 20 Lantern + 1 Iotic Essence

Beast Essence
